text: APPROVE: The Apply branch's nested ternary, early `continue` and lambda move into `AddApplier`, which cuts well over 10 points of complexity from `BuildPlan`. `continue` becomes `return` at the end of the loop body, so behaviour is the same. Dropping `var m = method;` is safe because a `foreach` variable is fresh per iteration. The new helper's signature uses `MethodInfo`, `ParameterInfo` and `Dictionary<Type, Func<object, object, object, object?>>`, and I couldn't confirm from the diff alone that `System.Reflection` is already imported or that the dictionary type matches the existing `appliers` declaration. I also didn't run the build or an analyzer to confirm the new complexity score.
